notes.title: Launch Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We have fixed the following bugs:
- Certain achievements weren't popping. They should be working now.
- The final stage of the game had a bugged camera, only displaying half of the Yuso on screen. The entire puzzle is visible now.
- Fixed a Korean language bug, Yuso now displays "Are you sure?" where appropriate.

Thank you for playing!
